profile.headline: software engineer at Cisco Systems
profile.summary:
Specialties: Call Processing Software Development, Networking Engineer, QA Engineer.
Cisco Routers/Switches.
CCNA

positions.title: Network Test Engineer
positions.description: Network Interoperability testing of Cisco and Juniper routers (Cisco ESR/GSR/CRS Juniper T1600).

positions.title: Test Automation Engineer
positions.description:
Worked on test automation to test Session Border Controller (SBC) area of the CISCO 7600, 12000, and ASR router systems. 
Reviewed and executed SBC test plans, document and track defects, automate tests for future regression when feature tests were successful.
Set up and integrated test equipments for SBC solution testing such as Cisco Call Generator, Routers, Switches, voice gateways, Gate Keepers, Navtel, Abacus, and IxVoice.  
Configured network using OSPF, EIGRP, BGP, and MPLS VPNs.  
Assisted team members troubleshoot and debug network issues involving IP, OSPF, EIGRP, and MPLS VPN issues.
Developed scripts that drove Navtel, SIPP (SIP Simulator), and Cisco Call generator test equipments for stress testing of SBC systems.
Took initiative to support the team by developing scripts using Expect that automated the installation of SBC loads for different SBC platforms.
Automated test script for regression testing of the CISCO BTS10200 softswitch.  
Developed scripts that reported and stored test statistics using PERL and mySQL databases.

positions.title: Call Control software engineer
positions.description:
Working in the Universal Call Engine (UCE) of the HiQ8000 switch.  The UCE is the central call processing engine of the HiQ8000 switch interface between MGCP, SIP, ISUP, H323 signaling managers.
Worked on PacketCable Event Messaging and ESP (Electronic Surveillance Protocol) project to meet PacketCable 1.5 specification

positions.title: Call Control/RSVP signaling software engineer
positions.description:
Developed call control and rsvp signaling software for the OMX switch to support GMPLS networking interface.
Used TCL to script test plans for unit and integration testing of call control and signaling software.
Designed and implemented simulation software on UNIX workstation to help test protocol software.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed call control and rsvp signaling software for the OMX switch to support GMPLS networking interface.
Developed script for unit and integration testing of call control / signaling software.
Developed simulation software on UNIX workstation to help test protocol software.
Cisco Systems

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description:
Developed Private Network-Network-Interface Multi-Peer Group (PNNI-MPG) simulator for integration testing.
Helped test PNNI signaling software using tcl scripts.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and support ISDN call processing software for the EWSD Digital Switching System. Worked on various call processing features.

positions.title: Software Consultant
positions.description:
Helped developed firmware on digital trunk board.  This project enhances the Harris Digital Trunk Unit (T1-DTU) module to detect DTMF digits and pass the digits to switch for IVR applications.
Designed and implemented Network Conference Manager feature for the Harris 20-20 PBX system.  This feature provides a user with the ability to graphically manage conferences.  The user can view conference members information and have control of conferences by being able to remove members from conferences or resetting conferences from a local or remote node.  Used ISDN PRI NCATSC (Non Call Associated Temporary Signaling Connection) to send/receive conference information.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description:
Feature coordinator for "calling Name Delivery" and "Visual Message Waiting Indicator". 
Assigned

positions.title: Software Engineering
positions.description: work on ISDN D-Channel Signaling for the EWSD switch.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description: Worked on Feature Control Call Processing area of the 5ESS Digital switch system.  Features worked on included Incoming Caller Indentification, Three Way Calling, and Call Transfer.
